title: Legal Brain Domain Plugin Manifest
description: Manifest describing one jurisdiction plugin for the Legal Brain. Each domain is isolated: its DB, vector store, and knowledge graph are all its own — cross-domain queries go through a mediator.

id.description: Kebab-case identifier, unique across all domain manifests.

enabled.description: Default activation state on registry load. Operator can override via API. Default false — a manifest is disabled unless explicitly turned on.

db_path.description: Filesystem path to this domain's exclusive SQL database. Never shared with another domain.

vector_store_path.description: Filesystem path (or 'unknown') to this domain's exclusive vector store directory.

kg_path.description: Filesystem path (or 'unknown') to this domain's exclusive knowledge graph store.

sources.description: Data sources the domain draws from. Empty is legal for stubs.

disclaimer.description: Long-form disclaimer shown before any answer. Never optional.

data_privacy.description: Privacy posture for this domain's storage.

user_docs_stored.description: Whether user-uploaded docs persist beyond the query.

permanent_corpus.description: Whether the domain retains a permanent, indexed corpus.

implementation_notes.description: For stub manifests: what must still happen for the stub to become real.
